description: Uniform Beta(1,1): every conversion rate equally likely a priori; adds 1 pseudo-success and 1 pseudo-failure.
Jeffreys Beta(1/2,1/2): objective, reparameterization-invariant prior for the Binomial model.
Informative Beta(5,995): encodes past campaigns averaging ~0.5% conversion (prior mean 0.005, strength of 1000 observations).
